attempts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: transparent game battle control overlay.
Input image 1 is the edit target. Recolor only this existing six-control ink-wash overlay into subdued BLACK AND FADED IRON-RUST RED ink. Preserve its exact six circular controls, relative positions and sizes, silhouettes and every glyph: two small controls stacked at left (running figure and circular arrow), three medium circles (shuriken/orb, pouch, shield), then one large sword attack circle at right with three small status dots along its top (two slightly lighter active dots and one dark inactive dot). Preserve the dry-brush broken outlines, wet ink washes, splatter texture, negative holes, sparse ragged flecks, and all spacing.
Color palette: predominantly soot-charcoal #292a29 to muted grey-charcoal strokes; secondary faded iron oxide ink #583f39 and #744c43. Restrict dusty dark red to a few glyph accents and attack details. Sparse muted warm grey-red #897269 is allowed only where needed for dark-scene legibility. Keep both contrast and chroma restrained: the controls should recede naturally into a dim grey-green fantasy scene. All marks are flat matte printed ink, including the dots, never luminous or glossy.
Critical edit: completely remove the source bright white, silver-white and cyan/turquoise coloring. No pure white, bright bone-white edge, bright cyan, neon, scarlet, saturated crimson, blood-red lava, gold, glow, emission, shiny bevel, metallic specular edge or jewel. No new art, text, backdrop or panel.
Transparency: truly transparent RGBA canvas. Spaces between all controls, the empty interiors between brush strokes and the open holes inside circles remain transparent and reveal the game ground underneath. No black rectangle, white rectangle, paper texture, background wash, checkerboard, filled backing discs or opaque panel.
Composition: same wide horizontal 3:1 strip as the target, full overlay visible with comfortable noncropped margins; request 1536x512 or preserve native 2172x724. Do not resize individual controls or rearrange anything.
attempts.outcome: Layout and real alpha preserved, but rusty brown coverage was too broad; one built-in palette correction requested.

attempts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: transparent game control strip, a single targeted palette correction of input image 1.
Keep the exact 2172x724, 3:1 composition, six circular controls, all glyphs, brush textures, broken ink edges, spacing, relative sizes, and true transparent holes and spaces.
The current result is too uniformly rusty brown. Change ONLY its palette and perceived material. Make at least 85 percent of the visible brush strokes neutral soot-charcoal and warm slate-black: #292a29, #343534, #454643, maximum sparse readable ash-grey #777970. Remove the brown copper cast from every outer ring and from the pouch, shuriken, shield, running figure, reset icon, and sword body. They should be primarily matte charcoal ink, no metallic bronze.
Keep restrained faded dark iron-rust red #583f39 to #744c43 on only a few inner glyph accents and attack marks, no broad red fill or wash. The two active top dots are small flat dusty reddish-grey ink dots (#897269 at the absolute lightest); the third stays dark charcoal. Flatten the shiny spherical dot highlights into mottled matte ink. Dim the pale light edges on the attack diamond into mid grey-red; no white or bone-white strokes.
All marks are matte dry/wet ink, never bevelled, jewel-like, glossy, emissive or neon. No bright red, saturated crimson, cyan, turquoise, gold, scarlet, blood lava, or vivid colored speckles. Low saturation and restrained contrast for a dark game battlefield.
Canvas is genuinely transparent RGBA: preserve every empty opening between marks and between controls as alpha transparency. No opaque filling, paper, black background, white background, checkerboard, panel or new element. Preserve native resolution if possible; no cropping or layout change.
attempts.outcome: Selected. Predominantly soot-charcoal with restrained dark faded rust accents, two slightly lighter active dots and one dark dot.

processing: Exact byte copy of the chosen built-in output. No programmatic color, cutout, composition, resize or pixel modification.
deviations: Built-in output preserved native 2172x724 rather than the alternative requested 1536x512.
Approximate palette rather than exact RGB assignment; generator retained subtle mottled light texture in active dots.

visualCheck.palette: Predominantly muted soot-charcoal, sparse dusty iron-rust glyph and attack accents; no visible cyan or bright red.
visualCheck.transparency: Open circle interiors and spaces between controls remain transparent.
visualCheck.layout: Six controls and three attack status dots retained.
